groups.title: Federal receipts, FY2025 – Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 4 (net of refunds, dollars converted to $ millions)

observations.caveat: Mostly state unemployment taxes deposited into the federal Unemployment Trust Fund; FUTA is a smaller part.

observations.caveat: Reflects tariffs in force during Oct 2024 – Sep 2025, including IEEPA tariffs later ended (24 Feb 2026) and now subject to refund litigation; the FY2025 figure is not reduced for those refunds.
